metadata.title: Streamflow Simulation Data from Differentiable HBV and LSTM Models Using CAMELS Datasets
metadata.description:
This record contains daily streamflow simulations and observations used in:

Li, P., Song, Y., Pan, M., Lawson, K., and Shen, C. (2025), “Ensembling differentiable process-based and data-driven models with diverse meteorological forcing datasets to advance streamflow simulation”, Hydrology and Earth System Sciences, 29, 6829–6861. https://doi.org/10.5194/hess-29-6829-2025

The simulation archive compares a data-driven LSTM and a differentiable HBV (dHBV) model driven separately by Daymet, NLDAS, and Maurer meteorological forcings. The six model/forcing combinations form axis 0 of each simulation array. Axis 1 contains ten archived realization members for ALL and three for PUB/PUR; these positions do not define one shared seed-label scheme across all models and experiments. Axis 2 contains 531 basins, ordered by py999_ids.npy, and axis 3 contains daily time steps. Streamflow units are mm/day and missing values are represented by NaN.

Files and evaluation scenarios

  • py999_ALL_simulations.npy — temporal/all simulations, shape (6, 10, 531, 10227), covering 1980-10-01 through 2008-09-30.
  • py999_PUB_simulations.npy — prediction in ungauged basins, shape (6, 3, 531, 6939), based on ten spatially stratified basin folds.
  • py999_PUR_simulations.npy — prediction in ungauged regions, shape (6, 3, 531, 6939), based on seven disjoint HUC02 regional groups.
  • py999_OBS.npy — observed streamflow, shape (531, 10227), covering 1980-10-01 through 2008-09-30.
  • py999_ids.npy — numeric int64 basin IDs in exact array order; format IDs as eight-digit strings for joins.

PUB and PUR arrays begin on 1980-10-01 to provide model context. Their principal evaluation window starts at index 5478 (1995-10-01) and ends on 1999-09-30.

Expanded documentation, the 671-gauge metadata, the 531-basin analysis subset, exact PUB/PUR split files, array schemas, and validation tools are maintained at:

https://github.com/pjlicn/ensemble-streamflow

The GitHub repository is a documentation and metadata companion. The files in this Zenodo record remain unchanged and are the authoritative numerical archive.

Citation and license

Dataset: Li, P., Song, Y., Pan, M., Lawson, K., and Shen, C. (2025), Streamflow Simulation Data from Differentiable HBV and LSTM Models Using CAMELS Datasets. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.16895228

The dataset and companion documentation are available under CC BY 4.0.
